R3-09 follow-up. A versioned discovery schema gained a field (BW-MED's `ds_receipt_keys`, R3-04) while its version const stayed put, and the version gate could not see it: every binding still agreed with the manifest, because the manifest had not moved either. The CHANGELOG and the pull request then claimed a bump that had not happened.

This file fingerprints each versioned schema's TOP-LEVEL PROPERTY SET. Change the shape and the fingerprint changes; if the version has not moved with it, `make versions` fails and names the schema. Regenerate deliberately with `python3 scripts/schema_shapes.py --write` when a bump is intended — the point is that the bump becomes a decision rather than an omission.
